capital_categories.method: Distribution (and, in New York, transmission) net plant growth split by the forward model's bau_plan.category_shares for this utility (growth / replacement / gridmod / other; status as in the utility JSON). Storm and resilience spending is not separable in Form 1 and sits inside replacement; IT and other = general and intangible plant (Form 1) plus the "other" share.

rr_bridge.note: Revenue requirement on a Form 1 functional basis for 2021 and 2025 (return on functional rate base at the allowed after-tax WACC, depreciation, O&M, taxes other than income, income taxes; general, intangible and A&G costs allocated to the scope by plant or O&M share; jurisdictional share applied), then the approved 2026 rate-case step. Computed in engine/lookback.py with the forward model's revenue-requirement structure.

property_tax_attribution.method: Plant-related property tax = the property tax / net plant ratio (Form 1 page 262 property and real estate taxes charged, all departments, / Form 1 page 200 net utility plant, all departments) x the scope's functional rate-base plant (scope net plant + allocated general and intangible plant, after the jurisdictional share). Property tax is assessed on plant value, so a uniform ratio attributes it to plant in proportion to net book value; assessed values, local rates and special-franchise valuation differ by plant type and locality, so this is an attribution, not a measured split. Non-plant taxes = the scope's taxes other than income (as in the detailed bridge) - plant-related property tax (payroll, gross receipts, franchise, sales and use and other taxes).

om_normalisation.check: Not driven by pension or retiree-benefit credits: Form 1 account 926 (employee pensions and benefits) is $7.5M in 2021 and $0.1M in 2025 (positive in both years), against administrative and general costs of $29.4M and $39.3M. Reported and normalised O&M are the same.
om_normalisation.method: Normalised O&M = reported O&M (Form 1 functional basis) - non-service pension and retiree-benefit costs in administrative and general, allocated to the scope by the same O&M share as the rest of A&G and then by the jurisdictional share. The detailed bridge keeps reported O&M; the grouped view uses normalised O&M and shows the non-service change as its own reconciling line.

2021.source: Check: Form 1 account 926 is 7.5 (2021) and 0.1 (2025) $M; not credit-driven, so no normalisation is applied
